coverage.scope: SBB extern-liveticker incidents (ENDED, <24h), all of Switzerland

notes: key is the line corridor text as printed in the incident description (e.g. 'Lausanne - Brig'). The CSVs contain NO OJP lineRef (ojp:91008:E) and no train/route numbers, so keys cannot be joined to OJP lineRefs without a separate corridor->line mapping.

lateProbability = share of days in the coverage window on which the corridor had an active unplanned disruption during that local (Europe/Zurich) hour. It is NOT a per-train lateness rate (no non-disrupted trips in the data).
expectedDelayMin = median total duration (minutes) of the disruptions active in that bucket; an upper bound on passenger delay, not a measured delay.
sampleSize = distinct incidents in the bucket; confidence: <8 low, 8-19 medium, >=20 high.

corridors: pooled over hours and both directions (A-B + B-A); see stats, joinHints, hourBaseline (nationwide, 24 rows) and stationAliases. Corridors with a single incident are kept with confidence 'very_low'; byLineHour cells with <8 incidents are dropped.
102 of 507 incidents had no parsable line corridor and are excluded.

joinHints.normalisation: fold(x): Unicode NFKD, drop combining marks, replace 'ß' with 'ss', casefold, replace every run of non [a-z0-9] with one space, trim. Apply to journey leg station names AND to stationAliases keys/values and corridor from/to/via. Two names are the same station iff fold() is equal after alias resolution.
joinHints.aliases: Resolve a name by looking up fold(name) in fold(stationAliases key); the value is the display name. Then compare fold(display). Aliases like Genf/Geneva/Zurich/Basel were NOT observed in the CSVs (CSV names are already display forms); they are provided for OJP/user input only.
joinHints.corridorMatch: For a journey, take origin and destination of the whole journey (and, if no match, of each leg). Match a corridor when {fold(from),fold(to)} equals {fold(origin),fold(destination)} (direction ignored: A-B and B-A were pooled). Prefer the highest sampleSize if several match.
joinHints.multiStop: Corridors with `via` (text with >2 stops) are keyed by their first and last stop only; via is informational. A journey also matches when origin/destination equal the endpoints. Do NOT match on a via stop alone and do not chain corridors.
joinHints.noMatch: Use hourBaseline[hourBucket of the departure, Europe/Zurich]. It is nationwide and NOT journey specific: show it as a weak fallback, never as a per-journey probability.
joinHints.confidence: Never display a probability for confidence 'low' as a number without caveat; sampleSize counts distinct incidents, not days.
joinHints.limits: Exact endpoint match only: a Lausanne-Genève journey will not match a Lausanne-Brig corridor even though it shares track. No geometry in the data.
